data.narrative:
Gritt is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $32.4M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private robotics firms and 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ), with top private peers including Humanoid, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, using the $32.4M total raised as a proxy base value, yielding an implied valuation of $65M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Generalist AI ($2.0B Series B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Humanoid ($1.4B Series A), and Walden Robotics ($1.1B Seed)—produces a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B.

The wide spread between methods reflects fundamental uncertainty about Gritt's relative position within the robotics sector. The stage-progression method anchors to capital deployed; peer-median reflects current market pricing for more mature private competitors. A reasonable valuation range is $55M to $1.9B, with a median of $857M. Key uncertainties include Gritt's specific product-market fit relative to the peer set, capital efficiency relative to fundraising stage, and sector-wide valuation compression risk.
